title: Alliance creation and global keyholder audit
synopsis: Configure new alliance messages and optional Owner-authorised disclosure at creation; staff keyholders now span every alliance.
changes: Create alliance includes description, recruitment message, MOTD and an optional 12–128 character disclosure passphrase. The creator receives Owner rank and an encrypted personal key.
Alliance Controlcenter Keyholders lists all alliances, including archived registrations, independently of the selected alliance.
Each reveal uses the exact alliance and Owner pair and requires the holder-provided passphrase. Secrets remain hidden by default.

title: Multihunter fleet farming analysis
synopsis: Staff can review fleet activity between two planets with transparent evidence and data limitations.
changes: Multihunters adds Fleet farming analysis with two planet selectors and a tick range.
Authenticated launch and battle reports record mission direction, fleet size, losses and captured asteroids with duplicate protection and round separation.
The report distinguishes insufficient evidence, repeated profitable raids and mutual profitable raids; staff review is required and no automatic sanctions are applied.
Practice-browser reporting starts with this release; missing or historical events remain unknown.

title: Arcade and Classic skins, Network Hub and fleet calculator
synopsis: Nyan Cat portal art, Classic game styling and clearer fleet command tools.
changes: Nyan Cat adds generated pixel artwork, rainbow frames and an arcade starfield to portal and manual themes; it joins all-theme cycling.
Classic adds a compact old-school in-game skin with red navigation, blue panels and bevel buttons.
Fleet Add to Calc loads that fleet as attacker and opens the calculator while preserving defender inputs.
Galaxy Forum appears under Foreign Affairs. Galaxy Status is renamed Network Hub across navigation and documentation.
Network Hub separates incoming, outgoing and returning fleets with an optional permission-aware alliance intel overlay.
Alliance Controlcenter Keyholders supports Owner-authorised passphrase disclosure to staff; rotating a key invalidates its previous disclosure phrase.
Multihunters has separate Raw access log and Multi subpages with staff-only access, account IP history and 30-day retention.
User Profile labels its portal appearance submenu Portal theme settings.

title: Profile audio controls
synopsis: Portal audio controls move into User Profile theme settings.
changes: The top-of-page audio controller is hidden.
Mute and volume controls are available under User Profile → Theme settings.
Portal playback and the separate opt-in game setting remain available.

title: Desert-space ambience
synopsis: Original cinematic portal ambience with an optional in-game soundtrack.
changes: The portal has a 96-second original generated desert-space score with mute and volume controls.
In-game music defaults off and can be enabled under Planet Settings → Ambient soundtrack.
The soundtrack pauses during portal video playback and while its browser tab is hidden.
Browser autoplay restrictions are handled with a clear starts-after-click status.

title: Unified round control workspace
synopsis: One round-settings and ticker workspace with duplicate controls removed.
changes: Round settings and Ticker & state become one continuous Round & ticker workspace.
Tick interval is configured once; Run one tick appears only in ticker controls.
Planet-tool shortcuts and duplicate reset-default controls are removed from round configuration; their own subpages retain those functions.
The two extra section-navigation buttons are removed while the main Admin Controlcenter submenu remains.
Portal, game, profile, forums, staff and achievement submenus share one themed tab style.

title: Staff controlcenters and private forum achievements
synopsis: Dedicated staff subpages and private alliance and galaxy discussions.
changes: Admin Controlcenter groups Round & ticker, Planet Editor, Stats Editor, Planet tools and Havoc in a shared submenu.
Alliance Controlcenter groups Overview, Settings, Members, Ranks, Funds and Structures with an alliance selector for staff.
Staff dummy assignments and planet alliance membership move to the Alliance Controlcenter Members page.
Multihunters has matching Overview, Case queue, Reports and Tools placeholders; no investigation or ban actions are active.
Private Alliance Forums and Galaxy Forum have dedicated menu entries and author-specific forum achievements.
Staff alliance edits remain server-authorised; personal Owner passkeys are not exposed to staff.
All portal and in-game manuals include the new navigation, permissions, fleet controls and forum workflows.
Achievement automation shows persistent ON/OFF, claimed totals and last-claim confirmation; Open Bonuses now navigates correctly.

title: Alliance Launch Bay and officer readiness
synopsis: A permanent fourth fleet, private member readiness cards and configurable command permissions.
changes: Alliance Fleet is a fourth deployable slot permanently controlled from Alliance Launch Bay.
Officers can view private member idle-fleet reports by ship type in separate themed cards under Defence.
Fleet readiness and Launch Bay are independent rank permissions, enabled by default for Owner, HC and Officer.
Central launch orders are validated by membership and permissions and delivered to the member’s open practice game.
Round reset clears fleet reports and pending launch orders. Unknown and stale snapshots are labelled explicitly.
Portal and in-game manuals cover all new fleet operations, vendor sales, government effects, support tickets, theme cycling and longer scored cinematic clips.
Alliance Forums is an alliance submenu with private topics and replies linked to the alliance-forum achievement.
Galaxy Forum is private to the current galaxy and linked to its own forum achievement.

title: Fleet operations and cinematic soundtrack
synopsis: Personalised fleets, prelaunch orders, vendor sales and longer scored battle concepts.
changes: Fleet names accept distinct 3–15 character alphanumeric names.
Fleet missions support 0–12 tick delayed launch and immediate cancellation before departure. Fake Defence recalls at ETA one.
Fleet travel now considers class, travel research, same-alliance defence and fixed five-tick in-galaxy defence.
Ship Analysis displays primary-target normal damage, EMP shots and stealing damage.
Vendor sales lock Base ships for twelve ticks and keep their value until settlement; the practice buyback rate is clearly stated.
Government mining, research and construction effects now modify the practice output rates.
Three battle concepts are 24 seconds each; the montage lasts 80 seconds and all include an original generated cinematic soundtrack.
User Profile Theme settings can cycle through all six portal themes on every reload; Remember setting controls persistence.

title: Command center, support and cinematic archive
synopsis: A unified Admin Controlcenter, private support tickets and a themed multimedia archive.
changes: Current Round Setup and Round State now share Admin Controlcenter with separate configuration, ticker, snapshot and reset boxes.
User Profile has private staff-support and ban-appeal tickets with a staff queue.
Portal multimedia sits above Command Operations and contains an interface montage plus three animated AI battle concept clips.
A dedicated Rules page is linked from the footer. Non-neutral portal themes receive brighter sci-fi framing and artwork.
Waves and Satelite Uplink receive themed graphics and clearer sections; the manual documents ownership and community support.

title: Alliance ownership and community controls
synopsis: Owner ranks, secure alliance recovery, forums and refined theme controls.
changes: Alliance creators receive Owner rank; only Owners or staff can add or remove an Owner.
Alliance Settings has separate name, description, recruitment message and MOTD editors.
Personal Owner passkeys are encrypted in the central database and allow reserved-name recovery and rank-projected private intel feeds.
Account-owned alliance settings survive a reset; gameplay resources, structures, scans and intel remain reset.
Community and private alliance forums support topics and replies. Discord chat is prepared with YouSMP configuration placeholders.
Portal themes move to the User Profile Theme settings tab with Remember setting. Theme changes reload portal or game.
Buttons inherit the selected theme with clearer text; Resource uplink no longer follows page scrolling.
Navigation uses Satelite Uplink, Journal, Achievements, Current Round Setup, Planet Editor and Stats Editor throughout.

title: Alliance construction and portal theme frames
synopsis: Three-tick alliance construction and stronger illustrated portal themes.
changes: All five alliance structures take three ticks to build and reserve their placement slot while queued.
Construction costs are paid once; effects and cooldowns start after completion.
Overview has a separate themed alliance-structures module with construction and active-effect progress bars.
Portal themes use larger artwork areas, illuminated sci-fi frames and inset synopsis, profile, lore and action boxes.
Alliance permissions continue to follow the account-owned planet after identity changes.

title: Universe analysis and continuous viewscreen
synopsis: KIA-inspired universe modules and a continuous RTS command viewscreen.
changes: Universe has modular top planets, top galaxies, civilisation distribution, size gains/losses, value ratios, crashers, combat activity and tick history.
History tracks observed ticks, with a maximum 24-tick comparison window; private alliance modules require the permitted intel overlay.
The RTS-style viewscreen extends from the themed left menu through the artwork and development controls to the planet box at the right edge, for every theme.
Overview identity updates immediately from Planet Settings.
Round reset preserves planet name, ruler name and public username while retaining account-owned alliance ranks.

title: Universe feeds and command profiles
synopsis: Text gamedumps, compact race profiles and clearer commander settings.
changes: The Universe Status panel offers planet, galaxy and alliance text dumps, plus a rank-protected private intel export.
Expanded race profiles use a wider layout without an internal scrollbar.
Manual navigation expands to its full height and scrolls with the page.
Planet Settings uses separate centred identity, sharing, quest, relocation and theme boxes.
Fleet transfers support all ships or individual ship classes.
Round reset clears opt-in checkboxes while preserving public usernames.
Race names and matching theme labels are updated throughout the interface.
Staff article editing is divided into identity, typography and body boxes.
News categories have distinct hues; section separators and command headers carry more themed artwork.
Planet and ruler names have independent save controls, restricted to the account-owned planet.

title: Compact race profiles
synopsis: Five centred race cards open detailed profiles through their plus controls.
changes: Five compact race cards share a centred desktop row.
Plus controls reveal doctrine, traits, bonus references and fleet artwork.
Expanded profiles close on pointer exit, Escape or focus leaving the card; touch users can toggle the plus button.

title: Themed manual chapters
synopsis: The entire manual is reorganized into illustrated chapters with larger pictograms and shaded subsections.
changes: Large theme-specific pictograms mark every chapter, with artwork and compact reference headers.
Top-level subsections use alternating shading and custom instruction panels.
Navigation, tables, flow cards and race profiles follow the current portal theme.

title: Race encyclopedia
synopsis: The portal presents detailed race profiles, characteristics, bonus references and ship artwork.
changes: Five illustrated race cards list doctrine, stealth, recovery, CU/RP bases, production and trade reference values.
Applied startup bonuses are separated from reference modifiers that are not implemented in the practice engine.
Each race links to Shipstats and the manual bonus guide.
Race encyclopedia links to the dedicated Races & bonuses manual chapter, which links back to the portal.

title: Portal footer navigation
synopsis: A themed footer provides five future navigation slots.
changes: About, Support, Rules, Privacy and Contact are placeholders in the portal footer.
Placeholder links show a Coming soon notice without navigating to missing pages.

title: Header layout repair
synopsis: The artwork header keeps the page grid, right rail and development navigation correctly aligned.
changes: The header wrapper is restored after replacing the breadcrumb with artwork.
Header artwork and command boxes wrap within the available width instead of displacing the resource rail.
Theme nameplate text no longer splits a race name mid-word.
The Vesper Chronicles module is placed above the Version changelog, after Race command profiles.

title: Structured ship order cards
synopsis: Production cards separate combat stats, target priorities, prices and order controls.
changes: A brief combat profile lists initiative, guns, per-gun damage, armour, ETA and role.
Target priorities and a full Shipstats link appear in their own summary.
Unit costs, quantity, autofill, fleet destination and order buttons use clearer spacing and subpanels.
Portal module 02 Race command profiles sits immediately above the Version changelog.

title: Quest automation settings
synopsis: Planet Settings can automatically claim completed rewards into the bonus bank.
changes: A centered Quest automation box sits below tax and sharing controls.
Auto-claim is off by default and after reset; enabling it collects only completed, unclaimed objectives.
Resource and point allocation remains manual on the Bonuses tab.

title: Universe alliance intel filtering
synopsis: Universe alliances and filters appear only through an authorized, enabled intel overlay.
changes: Apply alliance intel controls alliance visibility and filter options.
Alliance names come only from alliance intel records, with Unknown for missing reports.
Directory alliance membership is excluded from universe search and alliance statistics when overlay is off.

title: Structured news transmissions
synopsis: News Log uses illustrated event cards with separate report and metadata boxes.
changes: Each event has a graphical icon header, readable transmission body and individual tick/date/category boxes.
Existing research, production, battle, covert and Game updates color identities remain visible.
Battle details and calculator links remain structured inside the event card.

title: Release ledger and bulk quest claims
synopsis: The changelog is a separate statistical portal module and completed quests can be claimed in groups.
changes: Release ledger displays latest version, recorded releases and change counts with a statistical visual style.
Each quest category can claim all reached, unclaimed goals at once.
A final Claim all completed quests button collects all available rewards without bypassing objectives.

title: Illustrated field manual
synopsis: The manual documents current features with artwork, operational flow cards and visual reference tables.
changes: New chapters explain draft orders, bonus allocation, ticker scheduling and staff news publishing.
Manual artwork, icon headings, step cards and category color keys improve navigation and reading.
Practice-only systems and server-backed records are clearly distinguished.

title: News category artwork
synopsis: Article categories have dedicated backgrounds and recognizable color hues.
changes: Mechanics is purple, round updates blue, stats green, errors red and pause/resume yellow.
Category backgrounds and icon accents apply to portal news cards, the archive and staff article pages.
Pinned cards retain their 24-hour emphasis within their category color scheme.

title: Illustrated development navigation
synopsis: Mining, Construction, Research, Population and Planet Settings become illustrated theme-aware cards.
changes: Development cards use the active skin artwork with activity imagery, readable title strips and illuminated icons.
All eleven skins receive matching artwork and hover/selected treatments.

title: Asteroid draft orders
synopsis: Mining supports Order now, Add to order and a combined Order all confirmation.
changes: Asteroid drafts are saved without charging resources and can be removed or cleared.
Order all validates every type and confirms the complete rising-cost bill atomically.
Independent orders remain available and existing mining limits are preserved.

title: Theme artwork and scheduled ticker
synopsis: Every skin has dedicated header artwork; automatic ticker starts use a saved date/time without quest credit.
changes: The old breadcrumb and skin badge are replaced by theme-matched header artwork.
Round state can schedule or cancel a browser-practice auto-start using local date and time.
Automatic starts create a Game updates notice but never award ticker quest progress.
The tick progress bar is more visible and shows its percentage.

title: Planet command metrics
synopsis: The planet header displays Score, XP and Value in a polished theme-aware command panel.
changes: Current Score, XP and Value update with the planet name, ruler, coordinates and tick.
The header uses a compact metric grid, illuminated theme borders and clear number alignment.

title: Quest insignia and medals
synopsis: Theme-specific goal icons, reward badges and completion medals decorate the quest board.
changes: Quest goal symbols use custom frames for every interface skin.
Resource, research, construction and asteroid rewards display matching icon badges.
Completed objectives display a medal; claimed rewards upgrade it to gold.

title: Ticker confirmations
synopsis: Ticker start, pause and stop are highlighted in Recent signals and Game updates news.
changes: Round state has a separate Stop control alongside Start, Pause and Run one tick.
Every ticker state change confirms with a toast and prominent yellow/black news event.
Game updates is a dedicated on/off news filter category.
First start, stop and restart each unlock a unique lore quest awarding one asteroid of each type, claimable once through Bonuses.
Initial rendering waits until all feature definitions are loaded.

title: Command time display
synopsis: A clear header time box shows the current tick, next tick countdown and 24-hour UTC clock.
changes: Tick values and countdown use a readable theme-aware header box.
A live UTC HH:mm:ss clock updates every second and uses military time.
Tick interval progress freezes on pause and restarts with the ticker.
The header compares local and synchronized server UTC clocks and shows page load and server round-trip milliseconds.

title: Live universe banner
synopsis: The portal banner shows central planet, asteroid and alliance totals.
changes: An integrated theme-aware status box displays current shared universe counts.
Public aggregate statistics refresh every 30 seconds without exposing private planet data.

title: Reset sharing preferences
synopsis: Quick actions uses one preference box with sharing and alliance tax off after reset.
changes: Alliance tax, alliance scan sharing and public sharing reset to unchecked.
The three Quick actions controls share one box.
Personal scans remain available when alliance sharing is disabled.
Staff-written articles now join the portal News posts cards, sorted with version news by publication date.
Staff articles remain visibly pinned for 24 hours, then return to date order automatically.

title: Staff tabs and article editing
synopsis: Staff tools are organized into tabs with a published article list and edit/save controls.
changes: Staff tabs group round controls, users, news articles and round reset.
Staff-made articles appear below the editor; Edit loads an article and Save changes updates its existing entry.
Portal assets use versioned URLs to avoid stale publishing controls.
Article storage initializes safely when its migration has not run yet.
Covert results have their own blue news category and icon.
Quick actions merges tax and both scan-sharing controls into one box; all start unchecked after round reset.

title: Covert command
synopsis: Military gains a covert operations console with agents, guards, stealth, missions and instant reports.
changes: Nine operations unlock through the existing covert research branch and apply to practice target snapshots.
Mission costs, stealth, success checks, target alert and operation effects use Planetarion manual rules.
Personnel training and wages use explicitly labelled Starfall practice rates.
Quest bonus tab imports a one-time race-adjusted Planetarion startup grant and shows current balances.

title: Quest reward bank
synopsis: Review quest lore and rewards, then allocate unused resources, asteroids, research and construction bonuses.
changes: Every supported quest displays its lore and reward before completion.
Claimed rewards enter a persistent bonus bank under Quests; resource and asteroid rewards are accepted explicitly.
Research and construction allocations support partial progress and multiple completions with budget and cap validation.
Staff article editor fills the module width, with bold, italic, font and size controls and a right-aligned publish button.
News Log distinguishes green research, orange production and light-red battle reports.
Battle reports have a dedicated on/off news category filter.
Quest board and Bonuses are separate tabs in the same tab bar style as Alliance.
Planetarion startup bonuses are imported once, adjusted by race, and displayed as current unused balances; no unverified loyalty bonus is added.

title: Staff news publishing
synopsis: Create categorized articles from the staff panel with dedicated icons and public archive links.
changes: Game admins can publish titles, synopses and article text to the central database.
Five update categories each have a theme icon on the editor, news cards and article pages.
Public portal and news archive display staff articles newest first; article text is rendered safely.

title: Draft orders and fleet delivery
synopsis: Build a multi-ship draft, confirm it with Order all, and choose where each ship is delivered.
changes: Ship cards separate Order now from Add to order.
Add to order saves a draft without charging resources; Order all validates and confirms the complete draft atomically.
Each ship has a Base / Fleet 1–3 delivery choice, applied when production finishes.
Drafts can be reviewed, removed or cleared and survive reloads.
Adaptive sidebar spacing, structured combat news and calculator import.
Round state ticker start, pause, step and speed controls for the browser practice round.
Alliance news has a distinct icon and theme accent in both signal lists; Quick actions preferences have quests.

title: Population and government ship production
synopsis: Running ship orders now apply population and government production bonuses with a manual lookup.
changes: Shipwright allocation and government output bonuses add together and immediately update active order rates and ETA.
Population includes a government selector and a linked manual lookup.
Democracy and Totalitarianism cost discounts apply to new ship orders without repricing paid orders.
Government changes use a 72-tick revolution production penalty.

title: Planet command header
synopsis: Your planet identity and current tick are grouped in a theme-matched top-right command box.
changes: Top-right box shows home coordinates, planet name, ruler and current tick.
The box updates after planet edits, relocation and tick progression, and adapts to narrow screens.
Whole-round reset also clears claimed quest rewards and restores quest progress to the default round.
Quest checkmarks follow claimed rewards and all clear when the round is reset.

title: Round state reset control
synopsis: Round state has a separate Reset round panel with an explicit confirmation.
changes: Round state includes a dedicated game-admin Reset round box.
Reset opens Are you sure? and requires typing RESET before the entire round is regenerated.
Apply changes buttons in the planet modules have improved theme contrast.

title: Complete round reset defaults
synopsis: A reset restores the default race, fleet catalogue and support panels correctly.
changes: Fresh rounds explicitly initialize race, galaxy fund, quest claims and news filters.
The shared directory normalizes fleet identifiers after a reset so the base fleet editor displays the correct ships.

title: Independent planet editor modules
synopsis: Each planet editor module applies its own changes without modifying other fields.
changes: Separate identity, location, alliance, resources, asteroids, base fleet, experience, structures and status modules.
Every module has an Apply changes button and its own confirmation status.
Applying one module preserves unsaved values in the other modules.

title: Portal account and round controls
synopsis: Registration, user profiles and staff controls join the portal navigation.
changes: Top navigation includes Shipstats and News, plus Register / Sign up for guests and User profile for signed-in commanders.
Admin-only staff controls list accounts and assign available planets.
Users can save their public name and portal theme through User profile.
Admin round reset clears and regenerates shared planets, alliances, intel, scans and browser news while preserving accounts and passwords.
Reset generations prevent stale clients from re-uploading scans from a previous round.

title: Admin alliance membership repair
synopsis: Admin-assigned planets now appear in the correct alliance roster, including after reload.
changes: Member rosters are reconciled with centrally assigned planets for every alliance.
Stable planet IDs retain roles across planet renames and remove memberships from the old alliance when moved.
Existing missing member records are repaired when loading the shared directory.

title: Version list and code references
synopsis: The v0.53.0 article now presents release changes as a dated version list with readable code references.
changes: The v0.53.0 news article uses a chronological version list, newest first.
Each version includes its change list and short code snippets with reference links.

title: Intel nicknames
synopsis: Alliance intel now supports nicknames and suggestions for members awaiting planet assignment.
changes: Nickname column provides a free-text box with suggestions for unassigned alliance members.
Nicknames are stored centrally for your alliance and follow intel edit and visible-field permissions.
Nickname labels do not change actual alliance membership or planet assignments.
Users can set their public game username beneath Planet display name; login credentials are unchanged.
Galaxy Browser Intel overlay mirrors alliance intel nickname, alliance, relation and scan columns in display-only mode.
Apply to order # assigns the chosen factories to the active ship order without resetting progress or changing queued orders.
codeSnippets:
// Apply factories to the active ship order
applyFactoriesToOrder(state.production.orderNumber);

title: Command news archive
synopsis: News cards now match Command Operations, with short briefings and a dated archive linking to full articles.
changes: Portal news posts use the same themed card layout as Command Operations.
Each news card includes a short synopsis and a link to its complete article.
The news archive lists releases by date, newest first, with version numbers.
Alliance Intel relations are read-only text, with War in bold red. The redundant Open Intel column is removed; planet names and scan letters open dossiers.
News cards include sci-fi background illustrations with dark overlays for readable text.
codeSnippets:
// Dated news articles are generated from release entries
newsPath(release); // /news-v0-52-0.html

title: Alliance intel and fleet launch
changes: Alliance dropdowns list all in-game alliances without changing actual membership.
Relation selectors color intel rows: Ally green, War red, NAP orange.
Latest available scans appear as linked type letters, respecting rank visibility.
Portal News posts and a versioned changelog added below Command Operations.
Fixed Fleet 1–3 launch selections; missions now move ships into outbound orders with ETA and return correctly.
Galaxy Scan uses radio buttons and All scans, charging once for the complete sweep of unlocked scan types.
synopsis: Alliance intel gains diplomatic colors and scan links; Fleet Launch is fixed and Galaxy Scan offers All scans.

title: Shared command network
changes: Central planet directory shared by the ordinary and alliance intel browsers.
Central alliance intel with rank permissions, visible field controls and galaxy overlay.
Version notification beneath the left game menu.
Alliance fund donation and exchange with 5% loss and minimum reserve controls.
Alliance statistics replace creation after founding; futuristic portal and manual styles.
synopsis: A shared planet directory, protected alliance intel and configurable rank visibility connect the command network.
codeSnippets:
// Load the shared planet directory
await centralDirectoryRequest("/api/planets");

title: Fleet reference
changes: Dedicated Shipstats manual page with race table colors, ship artwork and resource icons.
synopsis: The fleet reference adds a dedicated Shipstats page with race colors, ship artwork and resource icons.
